'''Arian Vh'ra''' was a [[Sexes/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Helen Goldenfield]] captured Vh'ra, along with another pirate named [[Itr Fairla]], and held them in the basement of [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[The Ranch|ranch]]. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] helped Helen keep an eye on the pirates while she awaited the authorities. The pirates were then taken away by a pair of two [[Exogen-class dark trooper]]s.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Arian Vh'ra]]
Arian Vh'ra was a non-playable character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Arian Vh'ra spawned under the generic "commoner" template, their appearance was randomized under one of 120 possible depictions.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

Arian Vh'ra was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref name="P9">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="PA2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the "Honor" portion was minimally modified. The two captured pirates were given proper names with this update,<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> replacing the the generic designation "a fugitive" used in the original version of the quest.<ref name="SWG" />
